content.text:
Why Nvidia’s Chip Rivals Have Left It in the Dust This Week
It’s been a bad week for Nvidia —and to add insult to injury, shares of two of the chip maker’s biggest rivals have surged. The reality is that’s not really a major concern for shareholders of the world’s most valuable company.
